topic: Heat Energy and Changes of State
key_concepts: Heat is energy that flows from warmer objects to cooler objects.
Adding heat to a substance makes its particles move faster and vibrate more.
Temperature measures how hot or cold something is and is related to particle motion.
Heating a solid such as ice raises its temperature before it changes state.
During a phase change such as melting, temperature stays the same even while heat is added
Melting is the change from solid to liquid.
Freezing is the change from liquid to solid.
Evaporation is the change from liquid to water vapor or gas.
Condensation is the change from water vapor or gas to liquid.
A heat-versus-temperature graph can show a plateau during phase change.
